summary: MINISO Group filed a Form 6-K announcing its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 18, 2026, and the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025. The notice includes standard proxy materials and voting instructions for ADS holders. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. This is a routine current report covering ordinary corporate governance matters and annual financial disclosure, with no transaction or event that could be classified as a special situation under the defined categories.
